title: Yellowstone flood event 2022: high water in Lamar River Canyon
place: Lamar River Canyon, Yellowstone National Park, Wyoming, USA
audio: natural roar of the river (mean about -17 dB), kept as AAC
notes: Handheld, fairly steady view from a forested slope down onto a raging brown flood torrent pouring through the canyon with standing waves and spray; an eroded raw earth cut bank on the left, conifers framing the right edge (x 0.8-1.0), distant valley/sky top right. 0-14 s is one continuous shot with slight drift; the water is most violent at 3-10 s (spray cloud at x~0.6-0.75). Subject (the torrent) spans x 0.15-0.8, centre around x 0.5. Original is 36.2 s, 1920x1080 at 30 fps; at ~24 s the camera starts panning, which is left out. No people, no text, no logos, no damaged buildings.
fact_en: NPS: 'On the morning of June 13, 2022, Yellowstone experienced a 500-year flood event. Northern parts of the park received a combined 7.5-9.5 inches of rain and snowmelt in a 24-hour period.'
